ctx.x: But most of the bands on the road at that time were the big bands, not the ...

Well I guess they had smaller bands but the big bands had the names there. Well they could afford to pay them. Now it's kind of hard to pay a big band because the price is well. What they do, they still have them, was Basie now, you take the band that Basie's got. It was called Kansas City or something, see? And that was a big band. Basie was a piano player and they said he took the band over. Well they had a whole lot of big bands on the road. I just can't remember all the names, you know. And they were all good.
